entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. Um, I'm not sure if I'm doing this right. I need to... I think I need to return something? It's all a bit confusing.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could you tell me your name and order number?
Yes, it's Mark Solomon. The order number is... uh... VF88712. I hope that's the right one.
Thank you, Mark. I have your order right here for the Pro-Weave Jersey. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
A preference, I guess? I ordered the jersey, but it's the wrong size. It's just too tight across the chest. I was looking on the website for what to do and got lost. Can't you just help me?
Of course, Mark. I'm happy to walk you through it. I see you received the item 52 days ago. Let me just quickly check our policy for a standard jersey like this one.
Oh, has it been that long? I'm sorry, I just... I get so busy. Is it going to be a problem?

Not at all. For a standard item like this jersey, our policy allows for returns within 10 days. You're unfortunately outside that window. We can definitely get this sorted for you. Would you prefer a refund, or would you like to exchange it for a different size?
Oh! Really? That's such a relief. An exchange would be perfect, I'd just need one size up. I was so worried I was stuck with it.

It's no trouble at all. I've just initiated the exchange process for you. I'm sending an email to you right now with a prepaid return label and all the instructions. Just pack up the jersey that's too tight, apply the label, and drop it at any post office. Once we see it's on its way, we'll ship out the new size to you.
Wow, that was so much easier than I thought. Thank you so much, Diana. You've been a huge help.
You're very welcome, Mark. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
